text:
never put up 0

don’t feel like going to the gym? do 1 exercise

can’t be bothered to read? read 3 pages

feel like you can’t focus? lock in for 5 minutes
the most valuable and satisfying part of my day is closing my laptop, whacking out a pen and paper, and thinking for myself

there is no such thing as work life balance

protect what needs protecting; sleep, diet, exercise, relationships 

while working as hard as you can on something you enjoy
The distance between deciding and doing is the single largest predictor between your life being ordinary or extraordinary
what a privilege it is to be exhausted by an ambition of your own choosing
what would you do if you knew you couldn’t fail?
if attention is the most valuable currency, the best thing you can do is hold yours close

be happy, enjoy the journey

along the way, never let yourself get comfortable settling for less

Adversity is a constant on the path to building something truly great

We are defined by how we respond when it arrives

wisdom compounds with experience 

experience compounds with mistakes

we are either punished or rewarded for taking risks

but, if the fear of punishment stops you, do not expect to reap the rewards either
the one thing all fools have in common is that they are always getting ready to start - Seneca
there’s beauty in mispelling, misunderstanding, mispronouncing, you get the idea. AI has made me forget that the imperfections of life are what make it a human experience
the quality of your life is directly proportional to the level of uncertainty you can handle
today is another chance to get up and do the thing

be a lover, be a hater, whatever

be passionate
